name: deep-thought-skills
description: Christian's personal dt-* workflow skills for Claude Code, packaged as a plugin so every machine runs the same set.

plugins.name: deep-thought
plugins.description: The dt-* workflow suite: one flow from branch to open PR (create-branch, investigation, grilling, to-tasks, tdd-prep, implement, ship, pr-data), the review skills that guard it (code-review, overkill-code-review, pr-review, pr-defense), branch surgery (branch-update, merge-conflicts, inherit-branch, handoff), the sportsbook-ui specialists (storybook-creator, tailwind-migration-tool, test-account, pr-slack-message, ticket-refiner), the writing gates (unslop, unslop-code), an unattended runner (auto-develop), and the two skills that maintain the suite itself (skill-creator, auto-improve-skill). dt-ask-deepthought routes between them.
